thread:
sienna: Heads-up — SiennaField (customer of IntegrateSI) reporting intermittent 403s and TLS handshake drops when their fleet posts to our marketplace-edge ingest. They're blocked for go-live. Need a quick architecture review + escalation. Anyone available?

mike: tagging infra. can you paste the raw error and which host they're calling?

sienna: error from node `sf-fleet-03`: `POST /ingest/v2 HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
X-Error: identity-missing
` target host `marketplace-ingest.eu.redwood.example.com`.

hana: looking at our ingress: lots of ClientHello with no SNI, and some that set SNI to `marketplace-eu` (our canonical). When SNI absent, our vhost rejects with 403. also seeing a few TLS alerts 40 (handshake_failure).

raj: SI's agent release note shows they bumped libcurl and OpenSSL statically; there are known edge cases where SNI isn't sent if hostname resolution is weird. can we confirm we accept connections with no SNI for onboarding?

taylor: production policy requires SNI for virtual host routing. for onboarding we can enable a temporary fallback vhost that matches by IP but logs more. ops can flip it for a narrow time window.

sienna: customer prefers a short window so they can push a config. Proposed: 1) 30-min sync to verify SNI and certs, 2) SI pushes an agent flag to force host header/SNI, 3) fallback: agent writes to S3 bucket we pull from.

mike: we should also share the exact network preflight (IPs, ports, thumbprint) and a curl they can run. I'll draft and Hana can verify.

hana: preflight: allow outbound from SiennaField NAT `172.20.4.0/22` to Redwood ingress `35.198.12.0/24, 35.199.45.0/24` TCP/443. Required SNI: `marketplace-eu`. Thumbprint (sha256): `9A:2B:3C:4D:5E:6F:7A:8B:9C:AD:BE:CF:01:23:45:67:89:AB:CD:EF`. CA bundle: https://downloads.redwood.example.com/onboard/marketplace-onboard-ca.pem (temp link).

raj: quick curl they can run on node to validate connectivity + headers:

```
curl -v --resolve marketplace-ingest.eu.redwood.example.com:443:35.198.12.45 \
  https://marketplace-ingest.eu.redwood.example.com/ingest/v2 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Auth-Provider: integratesi" \
  --tlsv1.2 --ciphers 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256' \
  --cert /opt/integratesi/certs/onboard-client.pem --key /opt/integratesi/certs/onboard-client.key
```

taylor: ops will enable fallback vhost from 15:30-16:00 UTC. please confirm if that window works for SiennaField. if they still fail we'll enable mTLS trust for their onboarding CA.

sienna: 15:30-16:00 UTC works. i'll schedule a 30m call with IntegrateSI field, include the curl, CA link, and preflight checklist. thanks all — let's aim to have them green before EOD. :pray:
